tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs sam 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du slob ma 'jug pa'i mtshams sbyor smin byed bdud rtsi'i nying khu bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ 'dir mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma nyer lnga khrus byas la gral la 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu grub nas slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba dbang bskur ba zab mo nyan la don nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ 'dir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya rnams kyi bsam pa dang mthun par chos kyi rnam grangs du ma zhig gsungs pa yang bsdu na mdo sngags gnyis las/ 'dir sngags kyi theg pa yin/ de la yang rgyud sde'i 'dod tshul du ma zhig yod pa las/ 'dir ye shes rdo rje kun las btus kyi rjes su 'brangs nas/ mdo sde rtogs pa'i rgyud dang / bya ba'i rgyud dang / spyod pa'i rgyud dang / rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang / rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud dang lnga las/ 'di phyi ma yin/ de la pha rgyud dang / ma rgyud dang / gnyis su med pa'i rgyud las/ 'dir pha rgyud dam thabs rgyud yin te/ zla gsang thig le'i rgyud las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis/ /rgyud kyang rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ gtso bor gdul bya 'dod chags can 'dul ba'i ched du/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i skor dang / gtso bor gdul bya zhe sdang can 'dul ba'i ched du gsungs pa/ dpal gshin rje gshed kyi skor dang / gtso bor gdul bya gti mug can 'dul ba'i ched du gsungs pa rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i skor te pha rgyud sde gsum las 'dir dpal gsang ba 'dus pa la lugs srol gsum gyi nang nas/ skabs su babs pa ni dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa dang /

rgyud phyi ma dang / rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud dang bcas pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis legs par bkral ba'i gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba la/ sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po sta gon gyi skabs su bab pa yin/ de la sa'i lha mo sta gon du gnas pa dang / lha sta gon dang bum pa sta gon dang / sangs rgyas la gsol ba gdab pa dang / slob ma sta gon du gnas pa rnams las/ dang po bzhi kho bos grub zin nas/ da khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma sta gon du gnas pa la/ lus kyi bya ba nges 'byung bskyed/ /nang dbang bskur la khyad don zhu/ /spro ba bskyed de rgyun bshags bya/ /bsrung ba byas te mchod pas mchod/ /so shing dor la khyor chu blud/ /srung skud btags te ku sha byin/ /zab mo'i chos bshad rmi lam brtag /slob dpon gsol btab sdom pa bzung / /zhes pa ltar chos tshan bco lnga yod pa las/ dang po lus kyi bya ba khrus byas phyag dang 'jug pa'i yon phul nas/ rang rang gi gral la snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas gus pa'i sgo nas 'khod du gzhug ces 'byung bas/ slob dpon la 'jam pa'i rdo rje dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas slob ma sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul ba zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas/ gnyis pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan po bskyed du gzhug pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi ni cho ga las/ /'khor bzhi char yang rjes su gnang / /rang gi bslab dang shin tu ldan/ /theg chen la dga'i bdag nyid can/ /la la gsang sngags grub don gnyer/ /'di ni dkyil 'khor 'jug par byed/ /bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan/ /gzhan dag 'jig rten gzhan don gnyer/ /'jig rten pha rol gnyer ba yis/ /dad pa mang du bskyed pa yi/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug bya yi/

/tshe 'di 'dod par gyur pa la/ /'jig rten pha rol don med 'byung / /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer gyis/ /'jig rten 'di yi 'bras bu rgyas/ /zhes gsungs te/ sngags kyi dngos grub rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ye shes don du gnyer ba dag dkyil 'khor chen por gzhug par bya yi/ tshe 'di yi bde skyid dang phyi ma lha mi'i go 'phang dang / rang don du nyan rang gi byang chub 'dod pa rnams ni ma yin te/ de dag ni dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa la ma ltos par thabs dman pa gzhan la brten nas bsgrub tu yod pa'i phyir ro/ /de bas na bdag gzhan thams cad srid zhi'i pha rol du son pa'i mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa don du gnyer ba'i dad pa can blo gros dang ldan pa dag dkyil 'khor chen por gzhug par bya ste/ tshe 'di'i bde 'bras don du gnyer bas zhugs na pha rol gyi don mi 'grub cing / gzhan don du mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas la dmigs te zhugs na rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don bde blag tu 'grub pa yin/ de ltar nges par byas nas bsam pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khams gsum 'khor ba gang du gnas kyang skyon dang nyes dmigs kyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pa yin te/ de rnams la sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa ji lta bu yod na/ dmyal ba rnams la tsha grang gi sdug bsngal/ yi dwags rnams la bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal/ dud 'gro rnams la gcig la gcig za dang gsod pa dang bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal/ mi rnams la 'dod pa btsal gyis ma rnyed pa dang / mi 'dod pa thog tu babs pa'i sdug bsngal/ lha ma yin rnams la 'thab rtsod dang / lus gcad cing dral ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal/ lha rnams la 'chi 'pho dang / gong ma nas 'og mar ltung ba dang / mthar ngan song du skye bar shes pa na dmyal ba'i lus kyi sdug bsngal las kyang ches che ba'i sems kyi sdug bsngal yod par bshad/ 'o na sdug bsngal de dag las rang nyid gcig pu thar ba'i nyan rang gi byang chub thob par bya dgos pa yin nam snyam na ma yin te/

nyan rang gi byang chub ni rang don du spangs rtogs kyi yon tan ma rdzogs shing / gzhan don gyi 'phrin las rgya chen po mi 'byung / mthar 'tshang rgya ba la yun ring du byed pas blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis don du gnyer bya'i 'bras bu ma yin/ 'o na ci zhig don du gnyer bya gang yin na/ shes rab chen pos 'khor ba'i mtha' la mi gnas pas khams gsum gyi sdug bsngal las 'das shing / snying rje chen pos mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i sems can gyi don rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba'i mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya dgos/ de yang rang nyid gcig pu'i don ma yin te/ nam mkha' la mtha' med pa bzhin du/ sems can la mtha' med/ mtha' med pa'i sems can re res kyang bdag gi pha ma byas shing / byas res kyis gnod pa mtha' dag las bskyab shing phan tshad med pa btags pa'i drin can sha stag yin pa la/ 'di rnams 'dod pa ni bde ba 'dod kyang thabs la mi mkhas pa'i dbang gis la la ni sdug bsngal dngos la longs spyod/ la la ni sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba rngams po che la longs spyod/ ma rig ling thog gis ldongs/ thar pa'i rten gyi 'khar ba dang ni bral/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi dmigs bu bas ni ma zin/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i lam nas brdeg 'chos shing ngan song gsum gyi g.yang sar 'grim pa 'di rnams snying re rje snyam du mos pa mdzod/ snying rje'o byas nas bzhag pas mi phan pas/ 'di rnams sdug bsngal las bsgral bde ba la 'god dgos/ de'i nus pa da lta bdag la med/ bdag las lhag pa tshangs pa dang brgya byin dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la sogs pa la yang med/ su la yod na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kho na la yod pas/ bdag gis ma rgan sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ci nas kyang thob par bya/ de yang rgyu med rkyen med las mi thob pas rgyu rkyen gyi gtso bo rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba dbang bskur ba legs par blangs te dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung bsdom bgyi zhing /

lam la ci nus kyis 'bad pa bya'o snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems dung pa zhig bskyed 'tshal/ bsam pa de lta bus kun nas bslangs pa'i sgo gsum gyi dge ba thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rgyur 'gyur zhing / tshe 'di'i bde 'bras dang phyi ma lha mi'i go 'phang la sogs pa zhar byung gi tshul gyis 'grub pa yin te/ dper na 'bras lo legs na rtsa dang phub ma zhar las 'byung ba dang 'dra ba lags/ gsum pa nang dbang bskur ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon 'jam pa'i rdo rje yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa khyed rnams kyi lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs te lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur par mos/ de la dmigs te slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud de lha mo'i padmar babs pas khyod rang rnams skad cig gis 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sku can re rer gyur par mos/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs te/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud de lha mo'i bha gar babs pas khyed rnams 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sku can du gsal ba'i spyi bo na mar dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma thams cad dag par byas te dbang bskur ba dang / ye shes dbab pa 'dres pa lhan cig tu byung bar mos pa mdzod/ slar yang bha ga nas phyir phyung ste rang rang gi gral la 'khod par mos pa mdzod/ de ltar byas pas dgos pa ni dbang gi dngos gzhi ma thob kyi bar gsang ba'i chos rnams nyan pa'i snod rung du bya ba dang / de dag gi skabs su slob dpon la yang gsang sgrogs kyi nyes pa mi 'byung ba'i ched du bsgrubs pa lags/ bzhi pa khyad par can gyi don zhu ba ni/ slob dpon 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang gnyis su med par bzhugs pa la thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed kyi sdom pa sngon du 'gro ba can gyi rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa stsal du gsol snyam pas snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar nas 'di'i rjes bzlos lan gsum mdzod/

dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid stsal du gsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug par 'tshal/ /zhes gsol ba btab ste/ de'i don ni/ slob dpon la dga' chen zhes bos nas/ byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de bdag la 'tshal ba'i slad du dam tshig ste sngags kyi sdom pa dang / de'i steng du thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyun bshags las thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang / de'i steng du rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang bcas pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa stsal ba'i sgo nas thar pa chen po sangs rgyas kyi grong khyer du gzhug tu gsol zhes pa lags/ de ltar khyad par can gyi lam rdo rje theg pa la don gnyer gyi blo skyes pa de shin tu legs pa yin no zhes shes pa'i ched du/ lnga pa spro ba bskyed pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ khyod ni tshul can snod yin te/ /bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang / /da ltar byung ba'i mgon po rnams/ /'gro la phan par bzhugs pa rnams/ /de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga mchog bzang 'di brnyes nas/ /dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan med brnyes/ /mthu dang mnyam med ye shes des/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces gsungs te/ de'i don ni khyed rnams cho ga'i sgo nas bur byas zin pa de la nye ba'i tshig gis bos te khyod rnams theg chen gyi chos kyi snod yin la/

theg chen la yang pha rol tu phyin pa dang sngags kyi theg pa gnyis las mchog tu gyur pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa de khyod la bstan par bya ste/ rdo rje theg pa 'di ni spyir dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam yin zhing / khyad par du yang 'o skol gyi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po 'di nyid bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol du gsang sngags kyi lam la brten nas bdud btul zhing sangs rgyas su zin yang / 'jig rten pa rnams drang ba'i phyir du/ slar yang mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul gyis 'dzam bu'i gling du 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan te/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas rtag par zhen pa ldog pa'i phyir du mya ngan las 'da' bar bstan pa yin no/ /de bas na dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam rdo rje theg pa dang mjal ba 'di skal ba bzang ba yin pas/ kun mkhyen rdo rje 'chang chen po thob par bya ba'i phyir chos kyi bur gyur pa khyod sngags kyi theg pa las blo gzhan du mi 'gyur bar gyis shig ces pa'i don lags/ drug pa rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro bas skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar du bzhugs pa'i mos pa byas/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad 'khod nas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa thams cad yul thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum gyi spyan sngar stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas tshul bzhin du bshags par bgyi'o snyam pa dang / 'khor 'das kun gyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba la dga' zhing rjes su yi rang snyam pa dang /

de ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog cig snyam pas yongs su bsngo ba dang / yul thun mong ma yin pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro snyam pa dang / bdag gi dngos po dbul bar bgyi'o snyam pa dang / bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya snyam pa smon pa'i bdag nyid can dang / de'i ched du rdo rje theg pa'i thabs tshul rnams la rim pa bzhin du bslabs par bgyi'o snyam pa 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can te/ don de rnams yid la dran bzhin pa dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar te/ thun mong ma yin pa'i yan lag bdun pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gang zhig thog med sogs nas/ gnas par bgyi/ zhes pa'i rgyun bshags lan gsum byas pa la brten nas thun mong ma yin pa'i so thar dang byang sems kyi sdom pa sngar ma thob pa gsar du thob cing / thob zin yar 'phel du byed la/ nyams na sor chud par byed pa yin/ de ltar byang chub tu sems bskyed pa la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i ched bdun pa bsrung ba bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros te khyed rnams la dbang bskur ba la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyis las bum gyi chu slob ma la gtor te/ oṃ āḥbighnanta kṛta hūm̐ zhes pas bar chad bsrung ste/ slob dpon gyis dri'i chu rdo rje dang bcas pas khyed rang rnams 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sku can du gsal ba'i gnas gsum du mas rim gyis reg ste/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ zhes brjod pas/ khyed rnams kyi snying gar rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon po/

mgrin par padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar āḥdamar po/ spyi bor 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar oṃ dkar po rnams lam lam byung bar mos pa mdzod/ slob ma re re la hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ de ltar byas pas khyed rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum gdod ma nas sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs te rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor gnas pa cho ga 'dis ngo 'phrod cing gsal bar byas pa yin/ de ltar sems bskyed cing sgo gsum lhar byas ma thag pa de mchod yul du bzang ba yin pas/ brgyad pa mchod pa ni/ me tog dbu la phul nas mchod par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang / bdug spos shangs la/ dhū pe/ mar me spyan lam du/ ā lo ke dri'i byug pa thugs kar/ gandhe/ zhes pas mchod pa ni lus ngag yid gsum lhar shes pa'i sgo nas 'dod yon la ma chags par longs spyod cig ces pa'i don yin/ de ltar 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad bsrungs te lhar bskyed cing mchod nas/ dgu pa mthun rkyen dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa la thog mar so shing la brten nas brtag pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa rtse mor me tog gi cod pan dang bcas pa rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs pa de nyid khyed rnams phyag thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa'i slad du byin par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ āḥdzi hoḥbadzra saṃ ba dha ni swāhāḥ zhes pas byin pa'i so shing de rgyu rin po che gser ram dngul las grub par mos te/ so drud pa bzhin byas pas rtse mo'i me tog las 'od zer byung ba bzhin kha nas brgyud de khong par song bas tshe thog ma med pa'i sdig pa dang dbang gi ye shes skye ba la gegs byed kyi sgrib pa thams cad sman pa mkhas pas skyugs sman btang ba bzhin skyugs par mos te oṃ badzra ha sa haṃ/

zhes gsungs shing thal mo kha phye ste so shing gi ra bar ltos pa med par dor cig ces brjod la so shing ra ba khru gang gru bzhi dri bzang gis byugs pa la tshom bu dgu bkod par dor te/ rtse mo bdag nyid la phyogs na mchog grub/ steng du mkha' spyod/ 'og tu sa spyod/ shar du zhi ba/ lhor mngon spyod/ nub tu dbang / byang du rgyas pa/ mtshams rnams su bum pa bzang po la sogs pa'i dngos grub phran tshegs re 'grub par 'gyur/ de ni rnal 'byor chen po'i bum pa'i dbang gi snod rung du byed pa'i thabs yin te/ so shing gis so dang kha la sogs pa lus gtso che ba'i dri ma sbyong ba bzhin/ bum dbang gis kyang gtso bor lus kyi dri ma sbyong bar byed pa lags/ bcu pa rmi lam gsal por 'byung ba dang ngag gi dri ma sbyong byed khyor chu blud pa ni/ oṃ hrīḥbi shuddha sarba dharmā sarba pā paṃ ni tsa sya saṃ shwo dhā ya/ sarba bi kalpan a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes pas lan gsum byin la/ de ni gsang dbang gi snod rung du byed pa'i thabs yin te/ khyor chus ngag gi dri ma sbyong ba bzhin/ gsang dbang gis kyang ngag gi dri ma sbyong bar byed pa lags/ bcu gcig pa rmi lam la bar chad mi 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir du srung skud sbyin pa ni/ hūm̐ bzla zhing rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum btab pa'i srad bu gong ltar bsang sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i srad bu dmar po rdo rje slob ma'i lus tshad dang mnyam pa gsum sgril byas pa rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum gyis btab pa rdo rje slob ma'i sgo gsum gyi bar chad bsrung ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ slob dpon gyi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sta gon gyi lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi srad bu'i tshogs spyan drangs te/ dam tshig srad bu la thim/ zhes dang / srung skud thal mo'i bar du bzung la las sngags bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs te skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yas dang /

bud med kyi g.yon la nyis skor du bcings/ bum chu gtor zhing / oṃ āḥbighnanta kṛta hūm̐/ zhes bzlas pas brten par bya'o/ /de ni shes rab ye shes kyi snod rung du byed pa'i thabs yin te/ srung skud 'dogs pa shes rab ye shes kyi sbyang gzhi khams kyi bar chad bsrung ba'i ched du yin pa bzhin shes rab ye shes kyang khams bdud rtsi la dbang bskur ba lags/ bcu gnyis pa rmi lam mi 'khrugs pa dang mal stan lhag par gnas pa'i phyir du ku sha sbyin pa ni/ ku sha'i phon po che chung gnyis gong bzhin bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dhīḥlas byung ba'i ku sha che chung gnyis rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi rmi lam mi 'khrugs pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa gyur/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ dhīḥbazlas pas ku sha chung ba phyag g.yas dang / ha bzlas pa'i che ba g.yon du byin te/ de'i don ku sha 'di dag byed kyi rdzas bla na med pa yin pa ltar/ dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes kyis kyang mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad dag par byed pas/ ku sha sbyin pa dbang bzhi pa'i sngon 'gro lags shing / sngon byung bcom ldan 'das ku sha ma 'khrugs pa'i stan la bzhugs nas sangs rgyas pa bzhin/ ku sha'i stan la nyal te rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu mngon du byas nas 'tshang rgya ba'i rten 'brel lam du byed pa lags/ bcu gsum pa chos zab mo bshad pa'i sgo nas spro ba bskyed pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wā ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis sems can mnyam med don/ /bla med byed par nus pa yin/ /bskal pa bye ba du mar ni/ /sngon chad sdig pa byas pa gang / /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/

/tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos/ /skyobs pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par gyur/ /gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yin/ /ngan 'gro de yis spyod par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa/ /bdag nyid chen po kun gyis ni/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ /yongs su bzung ste skyed bzhin pa/ /de phyir khyod rnams theg chen du/ /sang ni rab tu skyed par gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /khyod rnams 'dir ni dong bas na/ /rab byung skal ba chen po pa/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni/ 'jig rten na u dum wā ra'i me tog dkon pa ltar du sangs rgyas dkon te/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul ston pa na/ de dang khad nye ba'i sa phyogs zhig tu u dum wā ra'i me tog gcig 'byung / de yang rgyal rigs las 'byung ba dkar po dang / bram ze'i rigs las 'byung na ser por 'byung la/ sangs rgyas de lhums su zhugs pa na me tog de kha 'bu/ bltams pa na kha bye/ gzhon nu rol rtsed mdzad pa na rgyas/ dka' thub mdzad pa na cung zad rnying / 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul ston pa na rgyas/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na shin tu rgyas/ mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston pa na skam nas 'gro ste/ des na de gnyis dkon mtshungs yin pas sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byon pa dkon/ byung nas chos gsung ba dkon/ chos kyi nang nas kyang theg pa chen po gsung ba dkon/ theg chen gyi nang nas kyang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gsung ba dkon/ dkon pas ci phan/ ri bong gi rwa dang nam mkha'i me tog kyang dkon no snyam na de dag dang mi mtshungs par dkon la phan yon chen po dang ldan pa yin te/

bskal pa bye ba du ma nas bsags pa'i sdig pa rnams dkyil 'khor chen po mthong ba'i mod la 'dag par gyur na/ dbang blangs te dam tshig dang sdom pa la nan tan du byas na sngags kyi spyod pa yid mtshan rtog las skyob pa'i thabs nyams su len pa dang / gsang sngags kyi bzlas brjod la brtson pa'i sgo nas lam 'di la blo brtan par byas na ngan 'gro dang srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgyun gcod par 'gyur ba lta ci smos/ de bas na khyed rnams kyis rnyed pa'i mchog legs par rnyed cing / rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus pas yongs su bzung ste/ de'i rigs su skye bzhin par 'gyur bas na/ theg chen gyi lam mchog tu gyur pa 'di la brten nas myur du 'jig rten gyi gnas lugs mngon sum du mkhyen pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur bar gdon mi za bas don de la dga' ba khyad par can dang ldan par mdzod cig ces 'bras bu la spro ba bskyed nas/ bcu bzhi pa rmi lam brtag cing ngan na bsrung ba ni/ bu kye sang ni dkyil 'khor dag /mthong bar 'gyur to nyal zhig dang / /rmi lam mthong na gang yin pa/ /de kun nga la drang por smros/ /zhes bshad pas rang gi sgrub pa'i khang par bde ba'i mal zhig bcas te/ slob dpon gyis gnang ba'i ku sha chung ba sngas dang / che ba stan du bting / gos dri ma med pa gyon/ glo g.yas pa 'og tu phab nas seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis nyal te dug gsum gyi rnam rtog thag ring du byas/ lha dang bla ma yid la dran bzhin pas/ sang nyin yi dam lha'i dkyil 'khor mthong bar 'gyur ro snyam pa'i dga' spro dung nge ba'i sgo nas dran shes bzhin dang ldan par nyal na lung ston pa'i rmi lam 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de yang rmi lam bzang ba'i ltas ni/ rmi lam sangs rgyas mthong na ni/ /yon tan rgya mtsho mngon sum bzhin/ /mchod rten dang ni sku gzugs mthong / /de la mchod pa rtsom pa dang /

/dge slong dag las chos nyan nam/ /yang na mi nyan na yang rung / /chos ni rnam par dpyod pa dang / /de bzhin mdo sde rnam par dpyod/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ rmi lam gyi gnas skabs su de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs dang mchod rten mthong ba/ dam pa'i chos kyi glegs bam thogs pa/ de dge 'dun gyi sde'i dbus su bzhugs pa/ rang gi bla ma las chos nyan pa/ nyi zla shar ba/ rgyal por dbang bskur ba/ rta dang glang por zhon pa/ nyi phug tu nyi ma lde ba/ dge slong dag dang chos kyi 'bel gtam byed pa/ zas bzang po ro brgya dang ldan pa thob pa/ 'bru'am bang mdzod la sogs pa'i gter rnyed pa/ skye bo mang pos bdag nyid la 'dud bstod byed pa/ skye bo mang po la bdag nyid kyis chos bshad pa/ pha ma dang bla ma dang mdza' bshes dang 'phrad pa/ gos rgyan bzang pos brgyan pa la sogs pa rmi na rmi lam bzang ba yin pas/ gsang sngags kyi dngos grub rab 'bring gang rung 'grub par shes par byas nas zhen pa med pa'i dga' ba bsgom zhing dga' ston bya/ gal te ngan pa yang 'byung srid de/ de'i ltas ni/ rgya skyegs kyi ri la 'dzegs pa/ ka ra bī ra'i me tog rgyas pa 'thu ba/ mchod sdong dang / bye ma dang thal phung la 'dzegs pa/ spre'u dang dom la zhon nas kha phyir phyogs te 'gro ba/ phag dang rnga mong dang ma he la zhon pa/ bud med nag mo gos nag can la 'dod log spyod pa/ g.yang sa dang gcong rong du zhugs pa/ ri dang shing las lhung ba/ khyi dang wa dang srin pos zos pa/ mi nag po lcags kyi dbyig pa can gyis bsdigs pa/ skra bregs pa/ lus la til mar gyis byugs pa/ phreng ba dmar po'i thod bcings pa la sogs pa byung na cung zad ngan pa yin pas/ gnyid sad ma thag tu chos thams cad rmi lam gyi snang ba dang khyad med de/ don la grub pa cung zad kyang med snyam du bden med kyi sbyang bas rgyas 'debs pa dang / sangs rgyas can gyi rnal 'byor bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag las 'byung ba bzhin lung blangs te nyams su len pa dang zhi ba'i sbyin sreg blug pa la sogs pa rmi lam ngan pa'i 'bras bu mi 'byung pa'i thabs la brtson par bya dgos pa yin/

bco lnga pa sang nyin rdo rje slob dpon du dbang bskur ba la/ do nub maṇḍal dbul bzhin gsol ba gdab dgos pa las/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal dbul ba zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba/ /stsal nas mgon pos bdag la ni/ /'khor lo lha yi de nyid dang / /slob dpon gyi ni las rnams dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /sdom dang gsang ba dam pa ni/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /rtag tu slob dpon bdag 'gyur gsungs/ /zhes gsol ba btab nas/ mdor na rigs lnga spyi dang khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams kyang 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan pos gzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa dbang ni brtan por bzung / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /padma'i rigs can dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/

/dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung / /ma sgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis grol/ /dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /de rnams kyis slob ma sta gon gyi bya ba rnams grub zin nas/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga sang nyin 'byung ba lags/ zhes brjod/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba'i brda sprod ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du zab pa bas kyang shin tu zab pa'i dbang bskur ba gsan la tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /snyam pa'i byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang / chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa yang / rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde rin po che rnams nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la rang re rnams rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus rnyed/ mjal bar dka' ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal/ bstan pa'i snying po rdo rje theg pa'i lam nyams su blang du yod pa'i skabs 'dir dam pa'i chos rnam par dag pa re byed dgos/ de'i rgyu mtshan don dam par sems can thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i sangs rgyas kyi snying po yin yang / gnas skabs glo bur gyi dri ma sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa ma spangs kyi bar la rgyun chad med pa'i sdug bsngal gyi 'khor mo yug tu gyur pa'i 'khor bar skye zhing / 'khor ba'i skye gnas gang du skyes kyang bzod par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig las ma 'das pa yin la/

sdug bsngal can gyi sems can rnams kyis pha ma ma byas pa gcig kyang med pas 'di rnams sangs rgyas kyi sa la bzhag pa'i slad du tshe 'di'i bya ba snying po med pa thams cad spangs te dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje dang shes rab zung du 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can gyis bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par bya dgos/ de'i ched du bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i lta bas rgyud sbyongs nas/ bskyed rim sgom pa la dbang bar byed pa bum pa'i dbang bskur ba dang / rdzogs rim sgom pa la dbang bar byed pa dbang gong ma gsum mtha' brten dang bcas pa blangs la nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa dung pa re bskyed mdzod/ dbang bskur ba la sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis las phyi ma yin/ de la sngon du 'gro ba slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa thams cad sngon du grub zin pa yin lags/ khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la 'jug pa dang / dngos gzhi gnyis la 'jug pa la/ /maṇḍal phul te gsol ba gdab/ /rgyun bshags rigs lnga'i sdom pa gzung / /'khyil bas bsangs shing gdong bcings nas/ /dris lan byas te me tog gtad/ /yon phul byang sems gsang bar gdams/ /yol ba'i nang gzhug dam la bzhag /maṇḍal gsol gdab ye shes dbab/ /brtan par bya zhing kha dog dri/ /me tog dor te mgo la bcings/ /mig ras phye la dkyil 'khor bstan/ /zhes pa ltar las/ thog mar slob dpon la 'jam pa'i rdo rje dngos yin snyam pa'i mos pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul mdzod/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dga' chen sogs nas gsol zhes gsol ba btab nas/ rgyun bshags bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa sogs nas/ gnas par bgyi zhes rgyud dag par byas nas/ mdor na rigs lnga sogs nas 'god ces dam tshig sdom pa 'dzin par khas blangs nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin sogs nas kṛta hūm̐/

zhes pa rnams sta gon ltar bya'o/ /dbang bskur ba la dkyil 'khor sngon du 'gro ba can yin pas/ sngon chad bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa'am zhugs kyang bskyar nas 'jug pa'i mtshon byed du ras yug dmar po res gdong dam du bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ā khāṃ bi ra hūm̐ gis bcings nas rigs nges par bya ba'i slad du/ sdug pa khyod su yin zhes dris pa'i lan btab par mos pa mdzad nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bdag ni skal ba bzang po lags/ zhes lan btab nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba'i tshe phyag stong par mjal du mi btub pas/ phyag rten gyi slad du me tog rigs lnga brgyus pa'i phreng ba re byin par mos pa mdzod/ ā khaṃ sogs kyis sbyin/ yon phul ba ni/ khyed rnams kyi lus longs spyod la sogs pa thams cad slob dpon la dbul bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ yul mkhar sogs nas bgyi zhes yon phul nas/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig 'dod pa des gsang sngags nang gi sems bskyed pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ sems can thams cad la phan pa bla na med pa bsgrub par bgyi'o snyam pa'i kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dung pa zhig bskyed de/ de nyid gzugs kyi rnam par langs pa las byung ba'i snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa nya gang ba lta bu zhig lam gyis byung bar mos pa mdzod/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba bde stong nam mkha' lta bu'o snyam du yid la byas te de nyid gzugs kyi rnam par langs pa las byung ba'i zla ba'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa zhig gsal lam gyis byung bar mos te/ de gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

oṃ sarba sogs/ dā ya mi/ thams cad rnal 'byor du sems bskyed pa de snying gar rdo rje bzhag nas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ su ra ti sogs nas/ su khaṃ zhes pas sems bskyed pa rnams phyi 'jug gi gtso bo yin pas brda don 'phrod pa gal che ba lags/ sems bskyed pa dang 'og nas 'byung ba'i gsang sngags kyi kun tu spyod pa rnams snod dang mi ldan pa'i mdun du smra bar mi btub bo/ /zhes gsang bar gdams pa'am gsang ba bsgrags pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs nas yin no/ /zhes pas gsang ba gdams nas nang 'jug gi slad du khyed rang rnams slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus te shar sgo'i nang du khrid par mos nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ āḥya mānta kṛta nas hoḥ āḥkhaṃ bī ra hūm̐ zhes dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i nang du 'khod par mos pa mdzod/ nang gi 'jug pa la sngon 'gro dam la bzhag pa bzhi'i dang po phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ deng khyod de bzhin sogs nas ta re/ nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' sogs nas gshegs/ mna' chu sbyin pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs nas ṭha/ bla ma'i bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ deng phyin chad sogs nas ta re/ zhes pa rnams sngon 'gro dam la bzhag pa yin/ nang 'jug gi dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin sogs nas gsol/ zhes pas gsol ba btab nas/ khyed rnams lus btsog pa gang la yang ma brnyes par me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar te sems gzhan du ma yengs par mdzad nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan nam sgyu ma lta bur shes par byas te de'i ngang nas/ khyed rang rnams 'od dpag tu med pa'i sku can du gsal ba'i rkang pa'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sogs nas as mtshan pa rten 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor rnams gsal btab nas/

slob dpon la 'jam pa'i rdo rje dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas khyed rnams kyi rkang 'og gi rlung la phog pas rlung g.yos te rkang mthil gyi dzheṃ me 'bar ba long bu gnyis kyi rtsa nang nas zhugs te brla'i rtsa bo che nas yar dmar khyug khyug song ste sum mdo'i me dang 'dres te me cher 'bar bas lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas snying kha'i sa'i dkyil 'khor tsha lam gyis bsros byung bar mos pa byas/ de'i rkyen gyis mgrin pa'i chu'i dkyil 'khor skya tho lo lo khol zhing / spyi bo'i rlung gis thur du mnan te lus bar snang du yed yed yod par mos pa byas/ de'i tshe slob dpon gyi thugs ka dang ba spu'i bu ga nas 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa phyogs bcur 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma thams cad 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i lha tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba rdul phran tsam tshad med grangs mi chod pa'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ khyed rnams kyi spyi bo'i gtsug dbang po'i sgo ba spu'i bu ga nas mar mtsho chen po'am rdo tshan la kha ba bab pa ltar sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ a we sha sogs brjod cing dbab/ de ltar ye shes phab pa'i byin rlabs kyi rgyun spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram bzhag ste brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tiṣṭha badzra zhes pas brtan par byas pas/ phebs pa'i rtags ni sku babs na nam mkha' la gar byed/ gsung babs na saṃ skṛ ta'i skad smra/ thugs babs na dus gsum shes pa la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur bas de nyid ngo shes par byas nas lam du srel ba gyis shig dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i ched du khyed rang rnams mig mig ras dang bcas bzhin pas dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi bar snang la bltas te mig gi lam du kha dog gang mthong ba zhig nged la smra dgos pas/

kye khyed kyi rmi lam na ci snang / /zhes dris la/ dkar po mthong na zhi ba/ ser pos rgyas pa/ dmar pos dbang / sngon po'am nag pos mngon spyod/ ljang gu'am sna tshogs sam khra bor mthong na las sna tshogs pa 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pas dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtags nas/ 'di na bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te/ de yang yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes gcig nyid gdul bya 'dul ba'i ched du gtso 'khor gyi rnam pa can du bstan pa tsam ma gtogs/ ngo bo la bzang ngan gcig kyang med do/ /'on kyang rang gis las bsags pa'i lha zhig la 'bab par shog cig snyam pa'i blos oṃ pra ti sogs gsung zhing 'bul ba'i tshul mdzod cig ces bsgos te gang la lhung ba'i nye ba de'i rigs su nges par byas la/ me tog de slob dpon gyis blangs te pra ti gṛhna sogs kyis lha la bos nas des kyang me tog gi phreng ba slar byin par bsams la me tog de slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag mig ras bsal te/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' sogs brjod/ ces bskul ba yin pas dkyil 'khor la gzigs shig ces bsgo/ de yang 'di na bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs te phyi rol na rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba me ri 'bar ba dang bcas pas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang chos 'byung kha dog dkar po'i nang du tshud pa'i sna tshogs padma 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i stegs bu la gnas pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sogs nas mdun gyi gdan re re dang bcas pa ni rten gzhal yas khang pa yin la/ brten pa lha ni dbus su bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa sogs nas/ byang sgor bgegs mthar byed sngon po sogs nas brgyad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /zhes sgrub thabs ltar brjod pa'am/

de tsam mi nus na dbus su bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa sku mdog gur gum gzhon nu'i mdog lta bu/ shar du rnam snang dkar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa sogs nas/ byang sgor bgegs mthar byed sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug ces ming tsam brjod pas kyang rung / gang ltar de ltar na lhag pa'i lha'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mthong ngo snyam du mos pa mdzod/ zhes pa de rnams lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga yin/ zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba la/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang dang / slob dpon gyi dbang gnyis kyi dang po la/ maṇḍal dbul zhing gsol ba gdab/ /chu dang cod pan rdo rje dang / /dril bu dang ni ming dbang dang / /thugs gsung sku yi dam tshig rnams/ /so sor ma 'dres rim bzhin bskur/ /zhes pa ltar las/ dang po rdo rje slob ma'i dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sogs nas/ deng bdag stsol zhes pas gsol ba btab pa ni sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la/ 'di ltar nges par bya ste/ don dam lhan cig skyes pa rang bzhin 'od gsal chen pos skye 'gro thams cad la khyab par bzhugs na yang / kun rdzob bag chags 'khrul pa'i dbang gis nga dang nga yir bzung ba la brten nas byung ba'i phung khams skye mched du snang ba ma 'gags kyi bar du sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig la longs spyod pas 'khor 'das kyi gzhi sems nyid kun tu sbyong ba bya dgos shing / de sbyangs pas phung sogs phyi rol gyi chos ltar snang ba rnams rang gi ngang gis ldog par 'gyur te/ rang sems dag ma dag tu snang ba las gzhan pa'i rang la 'khor 'das 'chings grol du med pas so/ /dper na sems nyid rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa don gyi sdom par nges pa'i shes pa brtan po dang ldan pa'i sgo nas dbang don dag bya dag byed ngo sprod pa gal che ste/

chos rje sa skya paṇḍi tas/ dbang bskur chos sgo tsam ma yin/ /gsang sngags rten 'brel lam byed pa'i/ /rten 'brel sgrig pa gdams ngag yin/ /phung po khams dang skye mched la/ /sangs rgyas sa bon btab nas ni/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas byed pa yi/ /thabs la dbang bskur zhes su btags/ /zhes 'tshang rgya ba'i phyi nang gi rten 'brel thams cad dbang nas sgrig dgos par gsungs shing / de yang sbyang gzhi rang bzhin gyis dag pa la dag par ngo shes pa'i shes rab dang ldan pa'i sgo nas kun rdzob tu ma dag par snang ba rnams lha so so'i dag pas sbyong dgos la/ des grol bar 'gyur ram zhe na rang sems 'khrul pa'i ngo bor ma dag par snang ba de nyid sngags kyis sbyangs te/ rang rig pa'i ye shes su shes par byas nas lhar bsgoms pas grol te/ rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i phyir sbyang du rung zhing / glo bur gyis ma dag pa'i phyir sbyangs dgos la/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi cha de glo bur dri bral du zhen nas zhugs pas/ zhen pas 'jug cing 'brel pas mi bslu ba'i phyir thabs des grol bar 'gyur te/ de yang sbyangs gzhi rags pa phung khams skye mched du snang ba'i chos sum cu rtsa gnyis/ sbyangs bya de rnams la tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog sbyong byed gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha sum cu rtsa gnyis/ sbyong tshul sbyong gzhi'i chos su snang ba de rnams sbyong byed kyi lha'am ye shes su kha dog bsgyur te bsgoms pas sbyangs 'bras gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha sum cu rtsa gnyis su 'gyur ba yin te/ de la yang gdan gsum gyi 'gro ldog shes dgos pas gdan gsum ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang gshegs ma'i gdan/ byang chub sems dpa' dang sems ma'i gdan/ khro bo dang khro mo'i gdan te gsum yin la/ de yang 'og tu spyan 'dren par 'gyur ba'i nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la gdan gsum dngos su tshang / mdun bskyed dang slob dpon dang dbang rdzas lhar bskyed pa la gdan gsum rnam dag gi sgo nas tshang /

de bzhi ka la'ang slob ma'i phung khams skye mched gdan gsum tshang bar byin gyis rlob pa'i cha nas gdan gsum phrin las kyi sgo nas kyang tshang zhing / slob ma lhar bskyed par 'gyur ba la gdan gsum rnam dag gi tshul gyis tshang bar shes shing bsgom pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas dbang len dgos pa 'di rnams la go ba rnyed pa gal che/ cho ga dngos la rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i rten la de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i dbang bskur ba la/ thog mar mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ las bum gyi chu slob ma dang dbang rdzas la gtor te/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ āḥbighnan gyis bsang / oṃ shū n+yā tas sbyangs khyed rnams kyis rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang / dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang nyi ma'i steng du khyed rnams kyis rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang / dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu gnyis ka mi bskyod pa sngon po sogs nas dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs te/ oṃ āḥya man sogs nas hoḥ khyed rang rnams la thim/ oṃ āḥya mān ta krita nas hoḥ dbang rdzas lhar bskyed pa la thim/ khyed rnams dang dbang rdzas lhar gsal ba'i mig tu sa snying dkar po sogs nas/ sku rdo rje dkar po zhes gsal btab nas/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer sogs nas dzaḥ zhes dbang lha spyan drangs te/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ badzri bha wa sogs nas chur gyur/ khyed rang rnams la yan lag bzhi pa sgrub pa'i slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa nas gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas skur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor pa rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig tu mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin gyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa gdan gsum tshang ba re thogs te/ khyed rang rnams mi bskyod par gsal ba'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/

rdo rje chen po'i sogs nas dbu brgyan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar khyed rang rnams mi bskyod pa gdan gsum tshang ba'i sku can du gyur pa la/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i rdo rje me tog la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badzra puṣpe nas shapta āḥhūm̐ zhes pas mchod nas/ de ltar na mi bskyod pa'i sogs nas rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /'og ma rnams la dbang lha spyan drangs pa dor nas/ lha dang dbang rdzas go bsgyur ba ma gtogs cho ga'i rigs 'gros 'di nyid sbyor ba yin pas rin chen 'byung ldan cod pan gyi dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ bsangs sbyangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi tshor ba'i sogs nas snga ma'i rigs 'gre shes par bya'o/ /'od dpag med dang / don grub dang / rnam snang la rang rang gi khyad chos dkyil chog na gsal lo/ /dbang de rnams kyi don ni/ rang gi dngos kun sogs brjod de/ zhes gsungs te/ de yang dngos po ste chos can gyi snang ba gang dang gang snang ba ni gtso bo ste rang gi lhag pa'i lha yin la/ lha de yang glo bur du byas pa yin gyi/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi rnyog pa dang bral ba'i phyir gdod ma nas lhar rnam par dag cing glo bur gyi dri ma rnams cho ga 'dis sel bar byed pas na/ da phyin chad de dag la tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog thams cad spangs nas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes su blta bar gyis shig de dag gis ni ma rig pa la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa lnga rig pa ye shes lngar sgyur bar byed pas sa'i dbang ngam/ rig ma can ma sogs pa'i thabs rig pa yab lnga'i las yin pas rig pa'i dbang zhes bya ba yin/ de rnams kyi chos can gyi snang ba thams cad lhar byin gyis brlabs nas de dag gi chos nyid drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' ngo sprod dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs par byed pa brtul zhugs kyi dbang bskur ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/

swa bhā wa sogs khyed rnams kyi phung po lnga'i chos nyid la tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog mi dmigs te sogs nas mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ de nyid la dam tshig gsum rim gyis sbyin dgos pa las/ thog mar rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig gi slad du hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje tshad dang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i lte bar rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum/ steng gi rwa lnga la rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i rigs lnga/ de'i 'og gi padma 'dab ma brgyad la/ spyan ras gzigs la sogs pa'i sems dpa' brgyad/ 'og gi rwa lnga la ye shes mkha' 'gro la sogs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma lnga/ de'i 'og gi pad 'dab brgyad la lcags kyu ma la sogs pa'i lha mo brgyad de lha nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa khyed rnams kyi phyag g.yas par byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'di de nas/ hi hūm̐ zhes pas byin pa'i rdo rje gsor te snying khar 'gying ba dang bcas pas bzung nas rdo rje'i de kho na nyid la thugs gtad par zhu/ thog mtha' sogs nas/ bdag po'i bdag zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/ rdo rje 'di ni chos kyi dbyings spros pa thams cad dang bral ba rig stong dbyer med kyi ngo bo mtshon par byed pa yin la/ rang gi sems thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i byang chub kyi sems spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nges don gyi rdo rje yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de ltar na thugs kyi dbang sogs nas mos pa mdzod/ des rdo rje'i brtul zhugs dang thugs kyi dam tshig gcig char du sbyin pa yin la/ dril bu gsung gi dam tshig sbyin pa'i slad du slob dpon gyis/ a las byung ba'i dril bu mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i bum pa'i nang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma yab dang bcas pa/ steng gi rwa lnga la rigs lnga rwa'i 'og gi pad 'dab brgyad la byang sems brgyad/ khog pa'i steng gi utpa la sgrol ma la sogs pa brgyad dang bcas pa'i lha nyi shu rtsa gsum gyi rang bzhin re khyed rang rnams kyi phyag g.yon du byin par mos pa mdzod/

'di de sogs nas bzhed/ ces pa'i sgo nas byin pa'i dril bu de nyid dku g.yon par kha gyen du bstan pas bzung ste/ dril bu'i de kho na nyid la thugs gtad par zhu/ srid pa nas byed par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/ dril bu 'di ni chos kyi dbyings spros pa thams cad bral ba/ skye 'gag gnas gsum gyi stong pa mtshon par byed pa yin/ rang gi ngag srid pa thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa ston par byed pa'i nges don gyi dril bu yin snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar na gsung gi dbang sogs nas gsung du mos pa mdzod/ phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams 'jam pa'i rdo rje sogs nas mnyam par sbyor pa'i sku can du gyur par mos nas/ rdo rje dang dril bu gnyis thugs khar bsnol nas phyag rgya'i de kho na nyid rgyas par brjod pa la thugs gtad par zhu/ gzugs sogs 'dod pa'i sogs nas snying po bzlas/ zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni tha mal pa'i bde ba ni ma dag pa'o/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal zad par bya ba'i phyir rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor bya ste/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la longs spyod cig 'dis rdo rje 'chang chen po kha sbyor gyi sku thob pa las mi 'da' 'o/ /de bas na ting nge 'dzin 'di la gnas par gyis shig de ltar na sku'i dbang thob sogs nas dngos yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ des slob ma'i dbang legs par grub nas/ gnyis pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la bzhir gnas pa las/ dang po ni/ bum dbang maṇḍal gsol ba gdab/ /dbang stegs lhar bzhag rigs lnga yi/ /mdor bsdus bskur zhing chu dbang bskur/ /rgyas btab rab gnas mchod pas mchod/ /rnam dag rjes gnang rtogs bskyed do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bum dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul ba zhu/ de ltar phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/

byang chub rdo rje sogs nas stsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor dbang stegs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa dar gyis bkab pa'i steng du/ khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sku can du gsal ba'i steng du bla bre/ g.yas su gdug g.yon du rgyal mtshan/ mtha' bskor kun tu dung dang 'phan la sogs pas bskor ba'i bkur bsti dang bcas te bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs te skur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bzhugs pa de rnams kyis bkra shis kyi glu dang rol mo'i sgra la sogs pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas rig pa'i dbang lnga mdor bsdus bskur dgos pa las/ thog mar mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin gyi chu'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang / slob dpon lhan cig pas bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje chen po'i dbang bskur ba sogs dang / rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rang bzhin gyi cod pan gyi dbang bskur ba'i phyir du nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang / slob dpon lhan cig pas cod pan gyi dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/ rin chen chen po'i sogs dang / 'od dpag med dang / don grub dang / rnam snang rnams la snga ma'i rigs 'gre'o/ /de ltar na rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur bas nyon mongs sogs nas byas pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ slar yang brtan pa'i slad du/ slob dpon gyis bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te chu dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/ dbang bskur rdo rje sogs brjod cing / slob dpon phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol bar mos/

phun sum tshogs pa nas gsum pa yin/ zhes gsung zhing sogs nas dbu brgyan par mos pa mdzod/ de la nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po chen por rab tu gnas pa byas par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha dang / de la mnga' dbul gyi tshul du nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sogs nas shapta āḥhūm̐ zhes mchod pa rgyas pas mchod pa dang bcas pas bum dbang gi dbang gi dngos gzhi yin no/ /de nas dkyil 'khor dang lha'i de kho na nyid bstan pa ni/ mi snyam pa sogs nas 'bras bur snang / zhes pa'i don/ gzhal yas khang pa ni lam byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun par dag pa yin la/ lha rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la sogs pa rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo yin no/ /zhes rnam dag bstan nas/ rnam gzhag bstan pa'i slob ma la rjes su gnang ba ni/ sman zhabs kyis/ de bzhin nas so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ slob dpon gyi las su bya ba dbang bskur ba dang / rab tu gnas pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig pa'i don yin lags/ de ltar na rdul tshon nam ras bris sogs nas thob par byas pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ gsang dbang maṇḍal gsol ba gdab/ /gdong bcings dmigs pa bdud rtsi blud/ /mig ras bsal la rtogs bskyed do/ /zhes pa ltar gsang dbang zhu ba'i yon du sogs nas gsol ba btab nas/ sngon chad kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mtshon byed du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsungs shing mig ras rnams 'ching bar zhu/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ bla ma 'jam pa'i sogs nas nga rgyal dang ldan pas lce thog tu bzhag ste gsang ba'i dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyis oṃ āḥmaṃ hūm̐/ zhes sbyin pa'i bdud rtsi de sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mos te bde ba sna tshogs kyis lus gang bar bsams nas/

kye ma shin tu bde chen zhes gsungs shing myong bar zhu/ de ltar myangs pas mgrin pa na gzhir gnas pa'i ya ra la wa zhes pa'i yi ge byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba dam tshig pa'i tshul du gnas pa la slob dpon gyis byin pa'i byang chub kyi sems gdan gsum tshang ba de nyid ye shes pa'i tshul du 'dres pa'i snang mched thob gsum gyi 'khor du byung ba'i rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa rag pa rnams 'gags nas stong pa chen po'i nyams skyes te snang ba gsum gyi rang bzhin stong pa gsum ro gcig tu gyur pa gsal zhing yangs la mi rtog pa rang byung gi ye shes stong gsal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes par mos pa mdzod/ de gsang dbang gi dngos gzhi yin/ dbang de thob pa'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsungs shing mig ras 'grol bar zhu/ de ltar na kun rdzob sogs nas byed pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ sher ye maṇḍal gsol ba gdab/ /gdong bcings dmigs pa dga' bzhi sprad/ /mig ras bsal la rtogs bskyed do/ /zhes pa ltar shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul mdzod/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sogs nas zhes pas gsol ba btab nas/ sngon chad phyag rgya bha ga'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mtshon byed du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas mig ras 'ching bar zhu/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rig ma yid du 'ong ba lang tsho la babs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhig sprul te khyed rang la gtad par mos pa mdzod/ gzungs 'di sogs nas zhes pas byin te/ khyod rang rnams 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang rig ma sogs nas ser pos bkag pa/ mkha' gsang sngags kyi byin gyis rlob pa longs sku lam du byed pa sngags kyi 'du shes/ thabs 'di la brten nas lhan skyes mngon du bya'o snyam pa chos sku lam du byed pa chos kyi 'du shes ste sku gsum lam du byed pa 'du shes gsum dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas thog mar phyag rgya'i gzugs la blta ba dang /

sgra la nyan pa dang / dri la bsnams pa dang / ma mchu'i sbrang rtsi myang ba dang / 'khyud pa dang tsum pa la sogs byas pa'i skad cig dang po la dga' ba'i ye shes bolla dang kakko la sbyar ba'i skad cig gnyis pa la mchog dga'i ye shes/ bsrub cing bsrub pa'i sbyor ba byas pa'i skad cig gsum pa la dga' bral gyi dga' ba'i ye shes/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i rang bzhin gyi rtsa btsal te snyoms par zhugs pa'i skad cig bzhi pa la lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nyams su myong bar mos pa mdzod/ de dag ni phyi go rim la ltos pa'i dga' ba yin/ nang gnas la ltos pa'i dga' ba ni/ de ltar snyoms par zhugs pa'i rjes chags kyi mes khams dwangs ma thams cad zhu nas spyi bo'i haṃ la 'dus te/ byang chub kyi sems spyi bo nas mgrin par byon pas dga' ba'i ye shes mngon du bya/ spangs bya nyon mongs pa kun brtag zhi ba nyan thos kyi lam chod/ mgrin pa nas snying khar byon pas mchog dga'i ye shes mngon du byas/ spangs bya nyon mongs pa lhan skyes zhi ba rang rgyal gyi lam chod/ snying kha nas lte bar byon pas dga' bral gyi dga' ba'i mngon du byas/ spang bya nyon mongs pa thams cad zhi ba byang chub sems dpa'i lam chod/ lte ba nas gsang gnas kyi bar du byon/ thabs kyi rigs kyi bdag po'i rtse mo dang shes rab kyi rtsa mdzes pa'i spyi bor byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar mjal bas spang bya nyon mongs pa thams cad zhi ba brtan pa byang chub chen po'i lam chod/ mdor na sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyang mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes zhes bya ba yin te/ rdo rje skyil krung sogs nas bshad/ de yas babs kyi dga' ba yin/ mas brtan gyi dga' ba sgrub pa'i slad du byang chub kyi sems mkha' gsang gi rtse mor rlung 'pho ba med pa'i stobs kyis bzung ba de slar yi ge hūm̐ gi gdangs can gyi rlung gis drangs pas rtsa dbu ma'i lam nas gyen du byon te lte ba'i 'khor lo gnas brten pa'i ming can gyi dbus su brtan pas dga' bas bsdus pa'i dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong /

rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu sprul sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas/ lte ba nas snying ga'i 'khor lo thams cad yod par smra ba'i ming can gyi dbus su brtan pas mchog dga' bsdus pa'i dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong / rnam smin gyi 'bras bu chos sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas/ snying ga nas mgrin pa'i 'khor lo kun gyis bskur ba'i ming can gyi dbus su brtan pas dga' bral gyi dga' bas bsdus pa'i dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong / skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu longs sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas/ mgrin pa nas spyi bo'i 'khor lo phal chen pa'i ming can pa'i dbus su brtan pas lhan skyes kyis bsdus pa'i dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong / dri ma med pa'i 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas/ de'i tshe byang chub kyi sems kyis lus thams cad la khyab/ de thams cad la bde bas khyab/ de thams cad la mi rtog pas khyab/ bde stong dbyer med kyi ting nge 'dzin skyes par mos pa mdzod/ de shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi dngos gzhi yin/ dbang de thob pa'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsung zhing mig ras rnams 'grol bar zhu/ de ltar ye shes sogs nas yin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ bzhi pa maṇḍal gsol ba gdab/ /gdong bcings dmigs pa mig ras bsal/ /rtogs bskyed dam tshig lung bstan dang / /dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod rjes gsum mo/ /zhes pa ltar dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul mdzod/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sogs/ zhes gsol ba btab nas sngon chad don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mtshon byed du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsung zhing mig ras 'ching bar zhu/ de la dbang bzhi pa'i rnam grangs ni/ tshig gi bzhi pa/ don gyi bzhi pa/ bzhi pa rten can/ lam du byed pa'i bzhi pa/ 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'i bzhi pa ste lnga las/

tshig gi bzhi pa gang la brten pa'i yul ni/ saṃ bu ṭa las/ zab cing rgya che la mos nas/ /tshig gi rin chen sbyin par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ slob ma bla ma dang shes rab ye shes kyi nyams myong dang / zab mo stong pa nyid dang / thabs rgya che ba'i rim pa la mos pa rnams la sbyin par bya yi/ de las gzhan la ni ma yin te/ bla ma la mos pa med na bla ma'i tshig la nges shes mi skye/ dbang gi nyams myong la mos pa med na thos bsam gyi lta ba dang khyad par med/ spros bral la mos pa med na 'dod chags dang khyad par med/ thabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mos pa med na gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i mthu med pas mtshan nyid de dag dang ldan pas bum pa la sogs pa'i dbang snga ma rnams thob pa'i slob ma la dbang bzhi pa sbyin par gsungs la/ de nyid tshig gi sgo nas ngo sprod pa'i tshul ni/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ dngos po sogs nas rang bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs te/ rgyud sde rnams las/ bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no/ /zhes mtshon bya mtshon byed du gsungs pa'i don/ mtshon bya don gyi dbang bzhi pa yang / sangs rgyas rnams kyi don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems yin la/ de'i mtshan nyid phyi rol pas btags pa'i dbang gi dngos po thams cad dang bral zhing / nyan thos sde gnyis kyis btags pa'i phung khams skye mched kyi chos dang / gzung 'dzin gnyis rnam par spangs la/ rnam rig pas btags pa'i gnyis med kyi shes pa tsam gyis rtog pa dang bral ba'i rang sems thabs kyi cha gsal ba ma 'gags pa de nyid skye 'gag thams cad dang bral ba mtha' bzhi char gyi spros pas stong pa'i stong nyid yin la de nyid/ slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas/ longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde chen rang bzhin med/ /snying rjes yongs gang rgyun mi chad dang 'gog pa med/ /yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas 'di nyid ni/ /bdag 'dod tshad med yongs bsgos blo can rnams kyang 'dod/

/ces gsungs pa ltar yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas yin no/ /de nyid dbang gsum pa'i ye shes 'dis mtshon nus pa yin no/ /zhes ngo sprod pa ni tshig gi bzhi pa ste/ ci ltar mtshon na/ dbang gsum pa'i dus su lha sku zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa gsal la ma 'gags pa de'i sems rgyud 'dzag med kyi bde bas gang ba/ bde ba'i ngo bo la bltas pa na phyi rol pa'i bdag nas/ rnam rig pa'i gnyis med kyi shes pa'i bar gyi rnam par rtog pa gang yang ma grub pa'i nam mkha' lta bu yin la/ de yang dmigs pa med pa'i snying rjes sems can gyi don rgyun mi chad pa yin pas/ des mtshon nus pas/ ye shes de nyid las kyi phyag rgya dang / rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyad pas mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi mthar phyin te/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yan lag bdun ldan mngon du gyis shig ces brjod pa ni lam gyi bzhi pa'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ de'i don nyams su blang ba'i ched du khyed rang rnams lus bsam gtan gyi chos dang ldan par byas/ ngag rlung rgyu ba sor bzhag sems dus gsum gyi rtog pa'i rgyu 'phrul gzhan thams cad la brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang gi sems su nges pa'i shes pa bskyed de/ sems kyi mtshan nyid gsal ba/ rang bzhin stong pa/ ngo bo zung 'jug gsum dbyer mi phyed par rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i sku bzhi rang chas su gnas pa de nyid/ 'bras dus kyi sku bzhi dang ngo bo dbyer med du nges shes bskyed de de mngon du byed pa'i thabs gzhan gyis tshig tu brjod pa la sogs pas rtogs par mi nus pas/ ngo bo dbang gsum pa'i ye shes kyi steng du ngo sprod de rtogs par bya ba ni/ rang nyid dbang gsum pa'i gnas skabs su lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam par snang ba rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i sku can du snang ba sprul pa'i sku dang / de'i sems rgyud phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyar ba las byung ba'i bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi rnam par shar ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang /

lha sku bde ba chen po'i rnam par snang ba tsam de nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum thams cad las grol ba chos kyi sku dang / de gsum ldog tshul tha dad kyang / rang bzhin so sor dbyer mi phyed pa ni ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ mdor na sems kyi gshis cir yang ma yin pa/ mdangs bde chen du ma 'gags pa/ rtsal sna tshogs su 'char ba/ bsgom bya sgom byed thams cad las 'das pa nam mkha' lta bu shes par byas la/ nam mkha' dang nam mkhar ro gcig pa ltar/ sems dang bde stong ro gcig pa'i ngang la 'dzin med du khong lhod glod de mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ de dbang bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi yin/ dbang de thob pa'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing mig ras rnams dgrol bar zhu/ de ltar na don dam sogs nas yin no/ /de nas dbang gsum pa dang bzhi pa'i dam tshig sogs nas bshad pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dam tshig rnams la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du gyis shig pa'i don du gsungs pa lags/ de ltar dbang bzhi thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams bskyangs pas de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan pa ni g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis chos gos snying gar bzung zhing g.yas pa mchog sbyin du byas la/ oṃ ngas khyod ces sogs nas 'grub par 'gyur ba yin no/ /zhes pa'i sgo nas lung bstan pas de ltar du 'gyur nges snyam pa'i dga' ba bskyed mdzod/ de nas dbugs dbyung ba dang / gzengs bstod pa ni/ mchog gsang dkyil 'khor dam pa 'di/ /zhes sogs nas/ rtag pa nyid du rtogs par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni/ snying po bde ba chen po len cing 'dzin par byed pa'i mchog tu gsang ba dam pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir khyed rnams btsud cing mthong ba la brten nas deng phyin chad sdig pa dang sdug bsngal las grol te/ bde ba chen po 'bras bu'i theg pa 'dir tshud pas na lam 'di la dga' ba khyad par can dang ldan par gyis shig de ltar byas na srid pa shin tu dag pa sku bzhi'i 'byor pa thob ste sems kyi don rgya chen po 'grub pa yin no/

/de rnams kyis dbang bskur ba yongs su rdzogs pa grub pas na gnas skabs de dag tu thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig thams cad la srung sdom bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos sogs nas/ gsung ni de bzhin bdag bgyid do/ /zhes pas dam tshig bsdus te 'dzin par khas blangs nas/ dbang yongs su rdzogs pa thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇḍal mdzod/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas lus longs spyod thams cad slob dpon la drin lan du 'bul/ cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te nas spyad du gsol zhes pa de rnams kyis slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis bskul ba'i gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba legs par gsan pas lam la 'bad pa dam tshig dang sdom pa la srung sdom la sogs pa'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod la slob ma rang gnas su btang ngo / /zhes pa 'di ni dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil chog kun mkhyen chen po bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa dang / kyai rdor dbang gi mtshams sbyor bsdus pa ngor chen thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa/ 'jam rdor dbang gi mtshams sbyor thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa rnams las ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin sa skya pa kun blos sde dge sman pa bla ma dkon mchog grags pa'i 'dod pa bzhin sbyar ba 'di'i zhal 'phangs pa rnams bdag 'jug bzhin yin pas rdo rje slob dpon dang po'i las can rnams la phan thog par gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 8 kun dga' blo gros/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma 'jug pa'i mtshams sbyor/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 9
